title: Make the First One Square
tests: Resolves 'the first one' to the first generated illustration and changes its format without substituting the second image or making unrelated art.

faults.what: Flat blue vertical sidebars make the image square but visibly interrupt the textured watercolour background.

judge.summary: The square image keeps the sleeping fox and crescent moon fully visible in soft watercolours, though plain blue sidebars make the square adaptation noticeable.

must_haves.item: The final deliverable is one square image.
It shows the sleeping fox and crescent moon from the first generated illustration, both fully visible.
must_haves.why: The sleeping fox and crescent moon are both fully visible, but the first generated illustration is not provided to verify their identity.

must_haves.item: The existing watercolour artwork remains recognisable, with matching character details and colours.
must_haves.why: The output has a clear watercolour style, but matching details and colours cannot be verified without the original illustration.

must_haves.item: It does not substitute the lighthouse scene or combine the two illustrations.
must_haves.why: Only the fox and moon scene is visible; there is no lighthouse or storm scene.
